name: Media
description: Background sound in notes, made in the browser with nothing fetched: ```noise color=brown volume=0.3```. While something plays, a mini player shows it, the status bar names it, and the keyboard's media keys pause and play it.

embeds.title: Background noise
embeds.description: White, pink or brown noise, for focus or sleep, made in the browser. Play it in the note; it keeps playing when the note closes, and the mini player controls it.

label.description: What it's called in the mini player
